gpt_discrepancies.gpt: VentureBeat-style figures for MotherDuck (100,000 articles, 40 s, 50 cents, 89%, OpenAI model 88% in nearly 32 min for $37.58)
gpt_discrepancies.where: secondary source E-15 (the GPT wording for this stream was not included in my brief)
gpt_discrepancies.finding: MotherDuck's own video page and product page do not show the 32-minute or $37.58 figures; the product page gives about $0.50 per 100,000 rows and a 10M-row calculator ($50 vs $3,758); one reading of the page also showed a 40 s headline, another did not.

gpt_discrepancies.gpt: Snowflake Decision is Jev-compatible / a Jev-class integration
gpt_discrepancies.finding: Snowflake's release note and both blogs do not mention Jev compatibility or a base model; they cite only the 'Jev Decision Index 0.2.1' benchmark. Databricks, by contrast, states ai_decide is directly compatible with the TypeSafe API but names no model.
Astronomer's own post says its 250,000-title production job runs on Snowflake AI_CLASSIFY today; Jev is a 4,000-title test and an upcoming Airflow provider feature.

gpt_discrepancies.gpt: LargitData routing scenario hosted on course.largitdata.com
gpt_discrepancies.finding: The scenario is on www.largitdata.com/en/blog (2026-09-20); the course subdomain root listed no Jev or routing posts. In that benchmark Jev scored 61.4% all-four-correct versus 77.0% for self-hosted Gemma 4 31B on 100 decisions.

gpt_discrepancies.gpt: Knowviq pipeline relevance -> answerability -> sentence support
gpt_discrepancies.finding: Knowviq's about page describes Jev scoring each claim against evidence and each result; the three tasks (result relevance, answerable gate, sentence support) appear in Knowviq's own 938-check evaluation, not as a published pipeline description. Knowviq has since moved to Clef on a separate /clef page.

gpt_discrepancies.gpt: TypeSafe launch date and Jev availability
gpt_discrepancies.finding: The TypeSafe post header says Sep 15 2026 while its metadata says Oct 19 2026; secondary sources use Sep 15. Microsoft-Decision-1 is dated Oct 13 (InfoWorld) vs Oct 9 (Waehner).
A Korean summary (Oct 1) says weights are not released; Liquid's current docs list open d1-3B and d1-omni-600M. Context window (32k vs 65,536) and input price ($0.02 vs $0.04) differ across listings.

gaps: The stream brief did not include the specific GPT claims for this stream, so checks_gpt is empty throughout and gpt_discrepancies lists source-vs-source and brief-wording conflicts instead.

No customer story naming an enterprise using Jev, Clef, d1, Perplexity Decisions, Laya, Kev or GLiDE was found; the TypeSafe Fortune-500 claim is company-stated with no names and was seen only via secondary outlets (pages not opened).

Not read: Fastino/GLiDE docs, TypeSafe docs and console, Laya repo (github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya), Hugging Face model cards for Clef, Perplexity decider, d1-3B, Microsoft Decision-1 (Tech Community fetch returned only a title), Cloudflare Workers AI changelog, Vercel's own report, OpenRouter pages (socket closed), Kai Waehner's 2026-09-28 post.

Not found or blocked: Oracle Select AI classification/boolean function docs (blog 403; docs pages lacked it), Amazon Aurora ML docs, pgai/Tiger Data docs, Glean get-started permissions URL (404), Onyx permissioning page (404), argilla.io/docs (404), Snowflake GA dates for AI_FILTER / AI_CLASSIFY / AI_AGG / AI_SIMILARITY (only the 2025-06-02 preview release note was seen in search results), BigQuery AI.GENERATE_BOOL model and status, BigQuery release notes beyond character 100,000.
No official source read on effective-dated (application-time) documents for retrieval; only SQL Server system-versioned temporal tables were read.

No paper was found that uses Jev or another System One model as the operator in a semantic-operator system; the cascade papers (E-41, E-42, E-43) use unnamed or generic proxy models. ThalamusDB paper was not opened.

No vendor page read defines a per-decision log schema, label store tied to a decision model, or evaluation-dataset versioning for decision models; the logging advice found is Waehner's (E-57) and the audit-logging recommendation from analysts quoted by InfoWorld (E-07).

Announced database or platform integrations found by 2026-10-23: Databricks ai_decide (Beta) and ai_query with SemIf-OpenJev; Snowflake Decision and Decision Fast (private preview, AI_COMPLETE); MotherDuck prompt_jev(); DuckDB jev / anofox_decide community extensions; pg-jev for PostgreSQL. None found for BigQuery, Fabric, ClickHouse, Redshift, Oracle, Cloudflare D1 in the pages read.

TypeSafe, Liquid, Cloudflare, Snowflake, Databricks, Fastino, Microsoft benchmark figures are all self-reported; the only head-to-head runs by non-vendors read are Knowviq (E-11), LargitData (E-12), Southbridge (E-13), Astronomer (E-14) and MotherDuck (E-26, E-27), each on its own small data.
